title: Manager-Field Engineer - Transport
description:
Vodafone Idea Limited is an Aditya Birla Group and Vodafone Group partnership. It is India’s leading telecom service provider. The Company provides pan India Voice and Data services across 2G, 3G and 4G platform. With the large spectrum portfolio to support the growing demand for data and voice, the company is committed to deliver delightful customer experiences and contribute towards creating a truly ‘Digital India’ by enabling millions of citizens to connect and build a better tomorrow. The Company is developing infrastructure to introduce newer and smarter technologies, making both retail and enterprise customers future ready with innovative offerings, conveniently accessible through an ecosystem of digital channels as well as extensive on-ground presence. The Company is listed on National Stock Exchange (NSE) and Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) in India.
  
  
We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer. At VIL, we know that diversity makes us stronger. We are committed to a collaborative, inclusive environment that encourages authenticity and fosters a sense of belonging. We strive for everyone to feel valued, connected and empowered to reach their potential and contribute their best.
  
  
VIL's goal is to build and maintain a workforce that is diverse in experience and background but uniform in reflecting our Values of Passion, Boldness, Trust, Speed and Digital. Consequently, our recruiting efforts are directed towards attracting and retaining best and brightest talents. Our endeavour is to be First Choice for prospective employees.
  
  
VIL ensures equal employment opportunity without discrimination or harassment based on race, colour, religion, creed, age, sex, sex stereotype, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, disability, marital and civil partnership/union status, pregnancy, veteran or military service status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law.
  
  
VIL is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversifying its workforce.
  
  
**Role**
**Manager- Transport Operations (**
**Field Engineer – Transport)**
**Job Level/ Designation**
**M1**
**Function / Department**
**Technology**
**Location**
**Kerala**
**Hiring Manager**
**Dhileep Mathew**
**Job Purpose**

* Responsible for Transport network ( Optics/DWDM/IP-MPLS etc) operations and the service experience

**Key Result Areas/Accountabilities**- Transport network acceptance with architecture compliance, quality of installation.
- Proactive plan to mitigate network risks due to environment or other factors Key Result Areas/Accountabilities
- Accountable to deliver the Network and service KPIs for transport network. Deliver service experience to Mobility and enterprise customers.
- Work closely with other functions in the circle and central to meet uptime, fault KPI, performance KPI and Change management KPI.
- Disaster recovery operations and situation specific solutions to improve experience for Voice and Data services
- Asset Management and spare management
- Responsible for preventive maintenance of transport network to reduce outages, alarms , performance issues and equipment damage
- Deliver the NOC demands, WFM compliance
- Maintain NDD and physical connectivity details
- Work with OEMs, transport, Infra ,OSP teams & NOC to reduce MTTR.
- Deliver quality of the network through optimization, rerouting, Core Competencies, Knowledge, Experience
- CCNA/JNCA/NRS-1 Preferred Critical screening points
- Transport Access (ECI, Huawei) DWDM (Huawei, Ciena, Nokia PSS) and IP (Cisco, Nokia) a. Understanding on technology Optics (SDH, Packet and DWDM) and IP (Routers and Switches) b. Vendor product understanding and day to day operational experience
Basic KPIs – a. Transport Network Availability >99.95%, MTTR of <4Hrs b. Alarms-SA and NSA Like RSL Deviation, CRC Errors, FCS Errors, High Temperature etc c. Performance Parameters – Latency, PacketDrop, Jitter etc
  
  
**Core Competencies, Knowledge, Experience**
5-10 Years of Transport network Experience in service provider/OEM environment
  
  

* Technical expertise in IP-MPLS/DWDM,OTN,MPLS-TP, Ethernet ,SDH etc
* Understanding of Mobility services such as 4G, VoLTE desired.
* Hands on experience in managing Huawei/ECI/Ciena/ZTE/Infinera/Tejas /Cisco/Juniper/Nokia devices in a multi-vendor architecture
* Experience in equipment installation
* Extensive travelling
* Ability to work in dynamic and matrix organization Must have technical / professional qualifications

**Must Have Technical / Professional Qualifications**


* BE/B.Tech/Diploma in Electronics/Computer science with 2-6 years of experience

**Vodafone Idea Limited**
(formerly Idea Cellular Limited)

title: Jr. IT Administrator
description:
We are looking for a motivated Jr. IT Administrator with 1 - 2 years of experience to support our users, systems, and IT infrastructure. The candidate should be passionate about troubleshooting, problem-solving, and learning BIM technologies.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Provide day-to-day IT support and troubleshoot hardware, software, and Windows issues.
* Support BIM applications such as Revit, AutoCAD, and Navisworks.
* Troubleshoot Software, Licensing, Network, and Connectivity issues.
* Assist with Active Directory, Group Policy, Microsoft 365, DNS, and DHCP tasks.
* Manage IT assets, software licenses, and user access.
* Support employee onboarding and offboarding.
* Maintain IT documentation and coordinate with vendors when required.

**Required Skills:**

* 1 - 2 years of experience in IT Support / System Administration.
* Good Windows troubleshooting skills.
* Basic knowledge of Active Directory and Networking.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving mindset.
* Passion for learning BIM software and technologies.
* Good communication skills and willingness to learn.

title: IoT Architect
description:
**Kerala Vision Broadband Limited** 
 is seeking an experienced
 **IoT Architect** 
 to join our
 **Solution Engineering – IoT \& Digital Solutions Team** 
 and drive next\-generation IoT, Smart City, and Digital Transformation initiatives.
 



 📍
 **Location:** 
 Ernakulam / Thrissur
 



 💼
 **Experience:** 
 8–14 Years
 



 🏢
 **Department:** 
 Solution Engineering – IoT \& Digital Solutions Practice
   




 ◆ Role Overview
 
 The IoT Architect is a broad\-spectrum technology strategist responsible for designing end\-to\-end IoT solutions across devices, connectivity, edge computing, cloud platforms, and application layers. As Kerala Vision expands its Managed Services \& System Integration (MSI) business, IoT is a key growth area covering Smart Cities, Industrial IoT, Smart Metering, Fleet Management, Healthcare IoT, and Building Management Systems.
 


 ◆ Key Responsibilities
 * Design end\-to\-end IoT architectures covering device, connectivity, edge, cloud, and application layers.
* Architect solutions using AWS IoT, Azure IoT, Google Cloud IoT, ThingsBoard, and similar platforms.
* Develop Smart City and Industrial IoT (IIoT) solutions for enterprise and government customers.
* Design IoT security frameworks including device identity, OTA updates, and secure communications.
* Support technical pre\-sales activities including customer presentations, solution proposals, BoQs, and RFP/RFI responses.
* Leverage ISP connectivity assets such as NB\-IoT, LTE\-M, eSIM, and APN services to build innovative solutions.
* Engage with OEMs, technology partners, and industry stakeholders to deliver best\-in\-class IoT solutions.



  




 ◆ Educational Qualification
 
 🎓 B.E./B.Tech in Electronics \& Communication, Computer Science, Information Technology, Telecommunications, or related disciplines.
 



 🎓 MCA / M.Sc. (IT/Networks) with relevant industry experience may also be considered.
 



 🎓 M.Tech / MBA (Technology Management) will be an added advantage.
 



  




 ◆ What We're Looking For
 
 ✔ Proven experience in designing and delivering end\-to\-end IoT solutions.
 



 ✔ Strong understanding of IoT connectivity, cloud platforms, edge computing, analytics, and security.
 



 ✔ Excellent customer\-facing, pre\-sales, and solution presentation skills.
 



 ✔ Ability to translate complex technical architectures into business\-focused solutions.
 



  





 📩 Interested candidates may send their updated resume to:
 



 careers@keralavisionisp.com
